<a id="v1-8-3-english"></a>
### English

> The multifunction panel now shows the tools that apply to the active workspace tab. SFTP tabs gain a remote terminal, and panel tabs focus their content when selected.

#### Important fixes

- The panel no longer keeps showing tools for the previous remote connection after switching to Settings or another unrelated tab. The local Terminal remains available.
- Clicking a panel tab focuses its content, and terminal tabs place keyboard input in the terminal.
- Panel and terminal instance list boundaries use a single separator line.

#### Important additions

- SFTP tabs offer a remote Terminal alongside the local Terminal and host performance. The remote session stays with its SFTP tab and closes when that tab is closed.

#### Other improvements

- The panel toggle sits beside Task Center. SSH terminal tabs keep quick commands, SFTP, the local Terminal and host performance in the panel, with the duplicate quick-command toolbar button removed.

#### Changes in this release

- Release v1.8.3: context-aware multifunction panel and single separators ([#84](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/pull/84), @JunXiaoRuo).
- Fix workflow test artifact downloads by name ([#85](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/pull/85), @JunXiaoRuo).

**Full Changelog**: [v1.8.2...v1.8.3](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/compare/v1.8.2...v1.8.3)

<a id="v1-8-3-zh"></a>
### 简体中文

> 多功能面板会根据当前工作区标签显示适用工具。SFTP 标签新增远程终端，点击面板标签后可直接操作对应内容。

#### 重要修复

- 切换到设置或其他无关标签时，多功能面板不再继续显示上一远程连接的工具；本机终端始终保留。
- 点击面板标签后会聚焦对应内容，切换到终端时可直接输入。
- 多功能面板和终端实例列表的边界统一只显示一条分隔线。

#### 重要新增

- SFTP 标签下可同时使用远程终端、本机终端和主机性能；远程会话跟随所属 SFTP 标签，关闭该标签时一同释放。

#### 其他优化

- 多功能面板入口移到任务中心旁。SSH 终端标签下保留快捷命令、SFTP、本机终端和主机性能，工具栏移除重复的快捷命令按钮。

#### 本次变更

- 发布 v1.8.3：多功能面板上下文与单条分界线（[#84](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/pull/84)，@JunXiaoRuo）。
- 修复工作流测试附件的按名称回读（[#85](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/pull/85)，@JunXiaoRuo）。

**完整变更**：[v1.8.2...v1.8.3](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/compare/v1.8.2...v1.8.3)
